headline: CIBN Urges Recapitalized Nigerian Banks to Expand SME Financing
summary: The Chartered Institute of Bankers of Nigeria has urged recapitalized lenders to expand access to affordable, long-term financing to meet growing industrial demands.
why: Nigerian commercial banks are undergoing a central bank recapitalization program aimed at boosting lending capacity and supporting broader economic growth.

impacts.name: Nigerian Banking Sector
impacts.why: Banks face calls to allocate recapitalized funds into commercial and industrial credit.
